import re

def valid_date(date):
    """Validate a date string in mm-dd-yyyy format per specified rules."""
    # 1. Non-empty string
    if not isinstance(date, str) or not date:
        return False

    # 4. Format: mm-dd-yyyy (two digits month, two digits day, four digits year)
    m = re.fullmatch(r'(\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{4})', date)
    if not m:
        return False

    month = int(m.group(1))
    day = int(m.group(2))
    # year is parsed but not used for validation beyond format
    # as per the specification (no leap year logic)
    # year = int(m.group(3))

    # 3. Month in 1..12
    if month < 1 or month > 12:
        return False

    # 2. Day limits depending on month
    if month in {1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12}:
        max_day = 31
    elif month in {4, 6, 9, 11}:
        max_day = 30
    else:  # month == 2
        max_day = 29  # per spec, allow up to 29 regardless of leap year

    return 1 <= day <= max_day
